source.citation: Mensch, T., Rasolofosaon, P. (1997). Elastic-wave velocities in anisotropic media of arbitrary symmetry - generalization of Thomsen's parameters epsilon, delta and gamma. Geophysical Journal International 128(1), 43-64.
source.location: Appendix B, p. 64, matrices (B1) to (B4), and section 4.1, p. 56

transcription.from: the PDF of the article, read on the images of pages 56 and 64 rendered at 150 and 170 dpi
transcription.note: Stiffness matrices in the two-index (Voigt) notation, rows and columns 1 to 6 for the pairs 11, 22, 33, 23, 13, 12, in GPa, written in the frame where C45 = 0. The Mesaverde sandstone and clayshale are transversely isotropic of axis 3, taken by the authors from Thomsen (1986); the Lavoux limestone and the Vosges sandstone are triclinic. All four matrices are symmetric as printed.

mesaverde_sandstone_density.description: mass density of the Mesaverde sandstone

mesaverde_clayshale_density.description: mass density of the Mesaverde clayshale

lavoux_density.description: mass density of the water-saturated Lavoux limestone

vosges_density.description: mass density of the dry Vosges sandstone

mesaverde_sandstone_delta_irm.description: relative distance of the stiffness of the Mesaverde sandstone to its isotropic replacement medium, equation (58)

mesaverde_clayshale_delta_irm.description: relative distance of the stiffness of the Mesaverde clayshale to its isotropic replacement medium, equation (58)

lavoux_delta_irm.description: relative distance of the stiffness of the water-saturated Lavoux limestone to its isotropic replacement medium, equation (58)

vosges_delta_irm.description: relative distance of the stiffness of the dry Vosges sandstone to its isotropic replacement medium, equation (58)

mesaverde_sandstone_V_P_ref.description: reference P velocity of the Mesaverde sandstone (vertical)

mesaverde_sandstone_V_S_ref.description: reference S velocity of the Mesaverde sandstone (vertical)

mesaverde_sandstone_epsilon.description: Thomsen's epsilon of the Mesaverde sandstone

mesaverde_sandstone_delta.description: Thomsen's delta of the Mesaverde sandstone

mesaverde_sandstone_gamma.description: Thomsen's gamma of the Mesaverde sandstone

mesaverde_clayshale_V_P_ref.description: reference P velocity of the Mesaverde clayshale (vertical)

mesaverde_clayshale_V_S_ref.description: reference S velocity of the Mesaverde clayshale (vertical)

mesaverde_clayshale_epsilon.description: Thomsen's epsilon of the Mesaverde clayshale

mesaverde_clayshale_delta.description: Thomsen's delta of the Mesaverde clayshale

mesaverde_clayshale_gamma.description: Thomsen's gamma of the Mesaverde clayshale

notes: Thomsen's gamma = (C66 - C44)/(2 C44) computed on the printed matrices (B1) and (B2) differs from the gamma printed in section 4.1 for the same media; the printed C66 equals C44 (1 + gamma) with the printed gamma, to the printed digits.
The gamma of the clayshale is printed 0.575 in section 4.1 (p. 56) and 0.573 in section 4.2 (p. 59).
